devconsole.title: API console
devconsole.intro: Build requests against this instance's own OpenAPI document, inspect the responses and copy them as cURL. Available only to administrators while developer mode is on.
devconsole.unavailable: The API console is available only to administrators while developer mode is on.
devconsole.loadFailed: The OpenAPI document of this instance could not be read.
devconsole.notice: Requests use your current session. The session cookie and the CSRF token are never shown or copied; credential fields and headers are masked. Playback and direct-delivery routes are not listed.
devconsole.bodyHint: Prefilled from the request schema; edit freely. Leave empty to send no body when it is optional.

problems.excluded: This route is not available in the console.
problems.body: The request body is not valid JSON.

devconsole.acknowledge: I understand this operation is dangerous
devconsole.acknowledgeHint: It can discard data, end sessions or change developer mode, and is audited.
devconsole.curlHint: Copied commands use placeholders for the session cookie and the CSRF token; credential fields are redacted.
devconsole.networkError: The request did not reach the server.
devconsole.binaryBody: Binary body of {bytes} bytes, not shown.
